## What this does

An **independent** re-check of the Round-10 build against landed ticket
contracts — fresh-eyes: code, tests, migrations, and public artifacts were
inspected *before* run-ledger verdicts were consulted, then run claims were
compared and discrepancies routed.

- **Verdicts published** (`docs/build/CAPSTONE_GAP_ANALYSIS.md` §(k)): all 38
  Round-10 requirement ids + 6 cross-stream seams — **34 MET, 2 PARTIAL
  (SIG-EVAL-001/002: machinery landed, human labels honestly deferred),
  4 MISSING** (SIG-EVAL-005/006/007 — owners deferred wholesale under
  D-R10-HUMAN-1, truthfully recorded; SIG-MEM-004 — owner P33.8 pending).
- **Artifact integrity re-verified independently**: p32.23a candidate
  (24 export + 18 release artifacts rehashed; GATE-G3 signed scope matches the
  artifact exactly — provisional, review-only, `applied=[]`, `decision=null`);
  p32.24 corpus (176 artifacts, completeness `complete`); p32.25 publish
  packet (`sig.release-publish-verification/1`, 25/25 pass).

## Real defects found and fixed in-ticket

1. **Stale coverage matrix** — 12 rows read `MISSING` although the owning
   tickets landed code+tests (`SIG-TRUST-001…008`, `SIG-EVAL-003/004`,
   `SIG-DOS-001/002`). Re-verdicted `MET`/`covered+tested` with fresh-eyes
   evidence columns + "P33.1 matrix repair" notes; deferred-owner rows keep
   truthful `MISSING` with recorded-deferral notes.
2. **Stale-leading DEFERRALS cells + audit blind spot** — 8 obligation rows
   recorded verified dated DONEs inside `OPEN`/`PARTIAL`-leading status cells
   in the `P31.x (YYYY-MM-DD): DONE` word order that `DATED_TERMINAL_RE`
   could not see (D-P30.1-2, D-P30.2a-1/2, D-P30.3-1/2/3, D-P31.1-2,
   D-P31.3-1 — the owed-work register overstated by 8). Repaired: shared
   regex extended (audit + events parser), cells reconciled under the P32.7
   convention (old values preserved verbatim), 8 `RECONCILIATIONS` entries,
   `migrate` re-anchored 97 events (`check` green).
3. **Drifted committed projection** — `docs/build/reports/current/` stale
   since P32.11; regenerated after all input edits.

## Deferral truthfulness

Every OPEN row scoped to the audit owes real work, verified against artifacts
(not asserted): `eval-confidence/1 mode="shadow"`; intake
`operational=false` + `receiver_not_operating`; all five return-pass packets
`prepared_not_executed`; `sqitch verify` count defect confirmed at
`db/verify/shared_temporal_contract.sql:30` (D-P32.10a-1 truthful);
legacy `sig.org.name` dispositions genuinely unrecorded (D-P32.3-1 truthful).
Round-10 closures carry named evidence. **No new DEFERRALS rows opened;
none closed** — the 8 reconciliations were status repairs of already-closed
work, not new closures.
